segments.text: This month's hair-length mark dropped way down.
But the eyebrow mark hasn't moved in months.
Every hair on the body cycles between growing and resting.
How long that growing phase lasts is set by body part.
Scalp hair stays in its growing phase for years.
Eyebrow hair's growing phase ends in just weeks.
Look again - the eyebrow mark hasn't moved at all.
Eyebrows stop growing sooner because their growing phase is short.
